narrative: CET1 is £409M on £3,262M of RWA — 12.5% in September, down from 13.2% at year-end (12.7% at June 2026) as lending grows faster than retained profit. The CET1 requirement is 9.57%; with a 1.5% management buffer the surplus is £48M, enough for about £430M more bridging at a 100% risk weight or about £1.2Bn of low-LTV BTL. Development finance at 150% is now the least efficient use of capital.
